about.p1: This site provides a simple and easy-to-use open source Age tool for people to generate new Age keys online, encrypt or decrypt messages.
about.p2: Built using Go and WebAssembly. The Go library Age is wrapped in a WebAssembly module and all actions are done in browser.
about.p3: There is no backend or API calls. Everything is generated on client (browser) side
about.p4: This site is Open Source and the source code is available on GitHub.
